title: Engine and app code
description: How Lathe's engine, server and desktop code is written, where the code already does the same thing every time. Each rule is followed and met rather than proved by tests; the rules the app's tests prove are the App code and App experience patterns, `LA-PAT-APP-CODE` and `LA-PAT-APP-UX`.

title: Domain modeling
description: How the domain models Lathe writes are shaped and named, its own and every product's, where the checks hold them to it.

title: Lathe's principles
description: The principles every part of Lathe follows, from mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) and standard work: mistakes are refused when they are made, each thing has one way, no rule has an exception, and a standard that proves wrong is changed everywhere at once.

title: Traceability
description: The bar Lathe's own spec holds on main: every obligation designed, built and proved, and nothing for the check to report.
